    from object_detector_tool import execute
    execution = execute(image_path, labels=["car", "person"], threshold=threshold, model_size=model_size, padding=padding)
    if len(execution['output_type']) > 0:
        if "box" in execution:
            for bus in execution['output_type']:
                if "box" in bus:
                    x_values = [item['left'] for item in bus['box']]
                    y_values = [item['top'] for item in bus['box']]
                    x_values.extend([padding for _ in range(len(x_values) - len(x_values)//2)])
                    y_values.extend([padding for _ in range(len(y_values) - len(y_values)//2)])
                    bus_label = bus['label']
                    bus_width = max(x_values) - min(x_values) + 1
                    bus_height = max(y_values) - min(y_values) + 1
                    new_box = [bus_label, bus_width, bus_height, [x, y] + [x + bus_width + padding, y + bus_height + padding], True]
